zoe_marketing: Quick heads-up 1 leads from last night's webinar landed as MQL but have no owner in HubSpot. A few also failed to sync to Salesforce.

lee_revops: Can you paste 2-3 HubSpot IDs so I can trace?

zoe_marketing: HS-11721, HS-11722, HS-11737. Workflow history shows 'assign attempt' then 'duplicate-check' then nothing.

mike_sales: Duplicate-check should be fast. If it stalls, we should still assign to the on-call fallback. Never block owner assignment on slow checks.

ops_jess: Looking now. We recently chained duplicate-check -> enrichment -> assign_round_robin. That ordering was meant to reduce noise but it's causing backpressure when ClearFirm (enrichment vendor) is slower.

nina_cs: For webinar leads we prefer immediate assignment because CS needs to thread in the followup. Can we special-case source=webinar?

lee_revops: Proposed immediate changes:
- If lead.source == webinar -> bypass duplicate-check/enrichment, assign to round-robin (with low priority token)
- For general MQLs -> assign immediately, trigger duplicate-check/enrichment async
- If duplicate-check flags duplicate -> reassign to revops-duplicates queue
- SLA: owner_id present in HS within 4 minutes of MQL (enterprise tag 12m)

ops_jess: I'll flip the workflow to assign-first + async checks. Also will add a small cooldown in round-robin to avoid sending >2 webinar leads to the same AE in 15m.

mike_sales: Can we ensure the HS->SF sync sets OwnerId via API immediately on HS assignment (no later job)? That prevents 'Lead w/o Owner' in Salesforce.

ops_jess: Yep. Current sync runs every 2 minutes; I'll add a push on assignment event.

zoe_marketing: Can we add one metric: marketing.mql_owner_within_sla_pct and emit 1/0 per lead? Want a dashboard gauge and an alert if <98% for 1h.

lee_revops: Add telemetry: marketing.mql_unassigned_count (1h) and marketing.mql_owner_latency_ms. Alert if unassigned_count > 10 in 1h or pct <98%.

ops_jess: Also adding a workflow audit log line so we can search for leads that were assigned but didn't make it to SF: `log_event("assign", contact.id, status)` in the assign handler.

mike_sales: For round-robin, exclude folks marked in /vacation calendar and anyone with flag "capacity=low". Use on-call list for overflow routing.

nina_cs: For leads routed to revops-duplicates, auto-create SF task "Investigate duplicate" with due=48h and owner=revops_queue_owner.

ops_jess: Action items:
- ops_jess: change workflow ordering to assign-first + async checks, push OwnerId to SF on assign, add logs (ETA: EOD today)
- lee_revops: implement SLA metrics + alerts, update routing rules for vacation & capacity (ETA: tomorrow)
- mike_sales: provide on-call overflow list and confirm SF task templates (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- zoe_marketing: upload sample leads & webinar runbook to #marketing-files for audit (done)

hs_pipeline_bot: Workflow 'MQL Assign v5' edited by ops_jess at 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z

ops_jess: Deploying change to staging now. Will run a quick smoke test with 10 synthetic webinar leads.

lee_revops: Great. If after 24h we still see >2% unassigned rate we'll convene a 30m postmortem.

zoe_marketing: Thanks team :rocket: Appreciate the quick turn.

mike_sales: I'll shadow the queue this morning and DM any odd cases.
